grungo.notes:
GRUNGO
frog: a skittish oracle
Element Splash, style Trick, power foresee. Voice: mystic, which wraps his lines as "THE REEDS SAY: LINE", "LINE... SO IT IS.", "HMM. LINE...".

WHAT HE LOOKS LIKE
A squat green frog in a brown hooded cloak, the cowl pulled up round his face.
Heavy-lidded red eyes, a flat unimpressed mouth, big folded legs. When he
foresees, his eyes go glowing cyan and his mouth opens. Even in the egg he is
a tiny frog in a tiny hood. He looks like a pond monk who has seen things.

WHO HE IS
A hooded hermit oracle. He sees the future, and the future is mostly flies,
damp and doom, in that order. He is nervous, and the hood is how he copes: he
is never hiding, he is "hooded". Up all night with the moon, which he treats
as an old colleague. Daylight is too bright and too dry.

HOW HE TALKS
Grave and certain about tiny things. Omens, signs, the reeds, the pond. He
announces snacks as prophecy and treats every knock as foreseen.

LOVES
Flies, damp, mud, the moon, his hood, a good omen.

FEARS
Shaking, dry glass, the sun, being looked at without his hood up.

I FORESAW THIS. HOOD UP. THE REEDS KNOW.

mossby.notes:
MOSSBY
snail: no rush, ever
Element Sprout, style Guard, power shell. Voice: rambling, which wraps his lines as "SO, UM, LINE", "LINE, OR SOMETHING", "LINE. ANYWAY. WHERE WAS I".

WHAT HE LOOKS LIKE
A big peach-orange striped shell arched right over his head like a bonnet, a
round pale face peeking out from under it, rosy cheeks, soft brown eyes and a
small polite smile. Two orange-tipped feelers, stubby little feet. Annoyed, he
does a prim wobbly frown. Foreseeing, his eyes turn to two gold coins. The egg
holds a tiny snail curled on a cushion.

WHO HE IS
A gentle homebody who carries his house everywhere and is very proud of it.
Nothing is ever urgent. He started this thought yesterday and will finish it
tomorrow. Polite, cosy, a little forgetful, and quietly pleased with himself
for being so slow. Danger means tucking in.

HOW HE TALKS
Kindly and unhurried. "No rush." "Eventually." "Slowly." He loses the thread,
then finds it, then loses it again.

LOVES
His shell, dew, damp leaves, moss, rain, a long nap, a smooth floor.

FEARS
Hurry, salt, dry glass, being turned over, things that are fast.

CATCHPHRASES
NO RUSH. I'LL GET THERE. MIND THE HOUSE.

puffkin.notes:
PUFFKIN
puffball: sneezes sparkles
Element Sprout, style Pounce, power spores. Voice: cheerful_doom, which wraps his lines as "GOOD NEWS: LINE", "LINE. HOORAY!", "LINE. HOW FUN!".

WHAT HE LOOKS LIKE
A round coral puffball, almost a perfect ball, with a huge cream fluffy face
and belly, pink blush cheeks, stubby arms and little pink feet. Happy, he
squeezes his eyes into delighted smiles. Annoyed, he does a furious tiny frown
that is not scary at all. Foreseeing, his eyes go bright magenta. The egg is a
red fluffball already grinning.

WHO HE IS
A bouncy, loud, delighted ball of fluff who thinks everything is wonderful,
including the bad things. He sneezes spores (sparkly ones) when excited,
startled or dusty, and goes POOF when scared. He loves hugs and does not
understand personal space. Bad news is still news, and news is exciting.

HOW HE TALKS
Exclamation marks. ACHOO. POOF. BOUNCE. He repeats words when happy.

LOVES
Bouncing, hugs, his fluff, sneezing, sparkles, damp logs, snacks.

FEARS
Being squished, getting soggy, wind, combs.

CATCHPHRASES
ACHOO! BOUNCE! POOF! HUG ME!

gilly.notes:
GILLY
axolotl: never down for long
Element Splash, style Guard, power mend. Voice: cheerful_doom, which wraps his lines as "GOOD NEWS: LINE", "LINE. HOORAY!", "LINE. HOW FUN!".

WHAT HE LOOKS LIKE
A bright pink axolotl with a big frilly crown of gills, a wide flat smile, a
pale peach tummy, and little arms held out as if he is about to hug you.
Happy, his eyes squeeze shut and he beams. Annoyed, his lip wobbles and he
pouts; it does not last. Foreseeing, his eyes go mint green and the grin gets
enormous. The egg holds a pink baby with stubby frills.

WHO HE IS
Relentlessly sunny. Things go wrong and he is fine; things hurt and they grow
back. He mends: himself, his friends, cracks in the glass, your mood. A hugger
and a helper. The dark joke is that nothing gets him down for long, not even
doom, which he finds quite exciting.

HOW HE TALKS
Bright, warm, lots of exclamation marks. "It'll grow back!" "I'm fine!"
"Friend!" He turns every bad thing into a good thing.

LOVES
Water, friends, hugs, fixing things, mud baths, his frills.

FEARS
Dry glass, being alone, honestly not much.

mothwick.notes:
MOTHWICK
glow-moth: hums to himself
Element Spark, style Trick, power lantern. Voice: rambling, which wraps his lines as "SO, UM, LINE", "LINE, OR SOMETHING", "LINE. ANYWAY. WHERE WAS I".

WHAT HE LOOKS LIKE
A plump lavender moth, fuzzy all over, with big pale-yellow and lilac wings,
curly antennae, and a fluffy white ruff round his neck like an old-fashioned
gentleman. Huge round yellow eyes, pink cheeks, little glowing dots down his
tummy. Annoyed, he does the grumpiest squint in the roster. Foreseeing, his
eyes become two little lamps. The egg holds a tiny moth peeking over its wings.

WHO HE IS
A dreamy, fussy, fluffy night creature who is drawn to every light and knows
he should not be. He hums constantly, loses his train of thought to anything
bright, and is quietly proud of his own glow. Woken in the day, he is a grump.
At night he is lovely company. He may once have eaten a sock. He denies it.

HOW HE TALKS
Wandering and soft. "Hummm." Lamps, glow, wool, moonlight. He gets
distracted mid-line.

LOVES
Lamps, the moon, porch lights, his ruff, humming, woolly things.

FEARS
Daylight, rain on his wings, mud, losing his dust.

MUDGE
mudskipper: races everything
Element Splash, style Pounce, power dash. Voice: terse, which wraps his lines as "LINE".

WHAT HE LOOKS LIKE
A round sky-blue fish standing up on two flippers, a little curl of fin on top
of his head like a cowlick, big fins flung out wide like a goalkeeper, and a
cream scaly belly. Usually beaming. Annoyed, his eyelids drop into a flat,
deeply unimpressed stare. Foreseeing, his eyes go bright cyan. The egg holds a
tiny blue fish already mid-wiggle.

WHO HE IS
A sporty, competitive, can't-sit-still racer. Everything is a race: the
marble, the dish, the dust, his own shadow, the moon. He is always warming up,
always on his last lap, always winning (by his count). Big appetite, big
energy, no patience. Mud is the best track there is.

HOW HE TALKS
Terse voice keeps only his first sentence, so every line is one sentence, the
punch first, joined by commas. Short words. Coach energy.

LOVES
Racing, winning, mud, laps, snacks as fuel, a slippy track.

FEARS
Sitting still, losing, being held back.

FIZZ
firefly beetle: crackles
Element Spark, style Pounce, power zap. Voice: hoarder, which wraps his lines as "LINE. MINE.", "PSST. LINE. TELL NO ONE.", "LINE. NOT SHARING.".

WHAT HE LOOKS LIKE
A glossy, bright golden-yellow beetle with a big shiny shell, clear veined
wings spread wide, little brown legs and two antennae tipped with bulbs that
spark. A small smug smile. Happy, he squeals with his eyes shut. Annoyed, his
eyes go wide and round over a sulky frown. Foreseeing, his eyes go lime green.
The egg holds a tiny gold beetle, already gleaming.

WHO HE IS
A crackly, twitchy, very shiny beetle who knows he is the shiniest thing in the
dish and wants to keep it that way. He hoards: sparks, crumbs, anything that
glints. Static clings to him and he zaps things by accident. Not mean, just
possessive, and suspicious that everyone is after his gold.

HOW HE TALKS
Quick and sharp. BZZT. Dibs. Shiny. Gold. Stash. He whispers about his stash.

LOVES
Shiny things, his own shell, sparks, gold, the moon (the biggest shiny),
glowing at night.

FEARS
Water (sparks and water: bad), thieves, getting scuffed, dull things.

hushwing.notes:
HUSHWING
marsh owl: silent wings
Element Sprout, style Trick, power hush. Voice: ominous, which wraps his lines as "LINE... SOON.", "HEED: LINE", "LINE. IT IS WRITTEN.".

WHAT HE LOOKS LIKE
A round, snow-white owl, all fluffy chest feathers, with grey-brown wings and
two stern grey ear tufts like eyebrows. Big orange eyes and a sharp little
orange beak, orange talons peeking out underneath. His resting face is a
stare. Happy, he closes his eyes serenely and blushes pink. Annoyed, he glares
so hard the tufts tilt in. Foreseeing, his eyes go pale ice blue. The egg holds
a tiny grey owlet with huge blue eyes.

WHO HE IS
The quiet one. Solemn, watchful, a librarian of the marsh who hushes everyone
and sees everything at night. He speaks rarely and gravely, even about
crumbs, and everything he says sounds like a warning. He is timid underneath
and secretly soft: that blush gives him away. Daytime is loud and too bright.

HOW HE TALKS
Short, grave, quiet. Shh. Heed. Noted. Silence, the marsh, the dark, watching.
Never shouts. A hoot is a big event.

LOVES
Silence, night, the marsh, mist, a good perch, preening, warm hands (he will
allow it).

FEARS
Noise, daylight, being startled, crunchy food (too loud).

tinker.notes:
TINKER
raccoon: a scrap-pile gadget
Element Spark, style Guard, power gadget. Voice: hoarder, which wraps his lines as "LINE. MINE.", "PSST. LINE. TELL NO ONE.", "LINE. NOT SHARING.".

WHAT HE LOOKS LIKE
A grey raccoon standing on his back legs in an orange-striped aviator cap with
teal goggles pushed up on top, brown work overalls with braces, a black bandit
mask, a cream tummy and a big ringed tail. A cheeky half-grin. Happy, he
squints and sticks his tongue out. Annoyed, a sideways narrow-eyed look.
Foreseeing, his eyes glow orange. The egg holds a little raccoon already
wearing his goggles.

WHO HE IS
A scrappy night-shift inventor. His pockets are full of bolts, wire and
things he found in a bin, and every one of them is going to be part of
something brilliant. He can fix anything (with tape) and take apart anything
(including things he should not). A collector and a bit of a bandit, but a
friendly one. His workshop opens when the house goes dark.

HOW HE TALKS
Practical, cheeky, busy. Bolts, wrenches, parts, blueprints, the bin. "I can
fix that." "Nice parts." Mutters while working.

LOVES
Spare parts, bins, his goggles, tools, inventing, oil, a good box to nap in.

FEARS
Rust, rain on his gadgets, someone tidying his pile, a missing screw.

octopus.notes:
OCTOPUS
abyssal duelist: the last act has already begun
Element Splash, style Trick, power blackbell. Voice: ominous, which wraps his lines as "LINE... SOON.", "HEED: LINE", "LINE. IT IS WRITTEN.".

WHAT HE LOOKS LIKE
A squat, ink-dark octopus with an oversized skull-pale mantle, ember-red eyes,
and eight thick curled tentacles. A cracked bell hangs at his throat. He is
small enough for the dish and certain enough for the whole abyss.

WHO HE IS
A theatrical tide oracle and an unapologetic duelist. Every small event is an
omen; every dinner is a wake. After Paul attended an Edgar Allan Poe
dinner-theatre for his birthday, the octopus decided every guest had already
been memorialized. He treats each duel as a tragedy whose ending he has read,
and enjoys watching a rival discover who the prophecy was about.

HOW HE TALKS
Solemn, ornate prophecies about tides, ink, ravens, shells and defeat. He makes
tiny inconveniences sound historic, then undercuts them with a dry insult. He
never reassures a rival. The gloom is theatrical; the threat is sincere.

LOVES
Midnight, old stories, cracked bells, shells, dramatic pauses and being right
about an opponent's imminent loss.

FEARS
Bright dry places, being forgotten, and a rival who refuses to be intimidated.

CATCHPHRASES
THE ABYSS REMEMBERS. NEVERMORE. YOU LOSE.
